description: Split the finance charge of a precomputed loan into the interest in each monthly payment under the Rule of 78 (sum of the digits), and work out the payoff after a chosen payment. Send principal (the amount financed), payments (how many monthly payments, 2 to 120) and ONE of: finance_charge (total interest in money), monthly_payment (the payment the contract states), or add_on_rate_percent (a yearly add-on rate, interest = principal x rate x payments / 12). Optionally prepay_after_payment (0 to payments - 1) to get the unearned interest and the payoff. Get back every payment with its interest and principal portion and the balance, the total interest, and the sum-of-digits weights. Federal law bars the Rule of 78 for refunds on consumer loans longer than 61 months; a note is added when payments is above 61. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/rule-of-78-interest). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

add_on_rate_percent.description: Yearly add-on rate in percent (precomputed interest = principal x rate x payments / 12).

finance_charge.description: Total finance charge (interest) over the whole loan, as the contract states it.

monthly_payment.description: The level monthly payment the contract states; finance charge = payment x payments - principal.

payments.description: Number of equal monthly payments (the term in months).

prepay_after_payment.description: Optional: pay off the loan right after this many payments have been made (0 = at once); gives the unearned interest and the payoff.

principal.description: Amount financed (what the borrower receives), in the loan's currency.
